name: What should I do if I smell sewer gas in my bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I smell sewer gas in my bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: First, pour a cup of water down any unused drains, including floor drains, to refill P-traps. Check if the toilet wax seal is intact. If the smell persists, open windows for ventilation and call a professional plumber. A plumber can inspect your drain lines, vent pipes, and plumbing fixtures to identify and repair the source of the odor. Do not ignore persistent sewer smells.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pour water down unused drains and check toilet seals. If the odor persists, ventilate your home and call a professional plumber.
